key_findings.native_fp8_conversion_disaster: kv.to(torch.float8_e4m3fn) without per-tensor scaling produces cos_sim=0.36 — DISASTER!
key_findings.speed_neutral: FP8 KV speed ≈ BF16 KV speed (0.98-1.03x) — no throughput benefit from raw FP8 conversion
key_findings.accuracy_problem: Raw FP8 E4M3 type conversion quantizes element-wise without scaling → huge quantization error → softmax amplifies → cos_sim=0.36!
key_findings.scaled_fp8_is_better: Python-simulated FP8 E4M3 with per-tensor scaling (scale=amax/448) → cos_sim=0.999996 — scaling is essential!
key_findings.production_note: vLLM's FP8 KV uses per-tensor scaling → cos_sim near 1.0 → must use scaled quantization, NOT raw type conversion
